steps.expected: A request to a /coach route returns HTTP 200. The response body contains at least one field such as 'message', 'suggestion', 'nudge', or 'coaching'. The UI reflects the response content without a visible error state.

steps.description: Verify personalisation — nudges reference user-specific context (habits or goals)
steps.action: Inspect the nudge or helper text rendered on screen for any user-specific reference (e.g. habit name, goal title, streak count, task due date).
steps.expected: The nudge content includes at least one piece of user-specific information (habit name, goal, challenge, or task) rather than being a generic static placeholder string. This confirms the backend is personalising output for the QA account.

steps.description: Observe nudge panel state — action buttons are optional (endpoint returns 204 when no active nudges for QA account)
steps.action: Observe whether the nudge panel shows any active nudges with action buttons (Dismiss, Acknowledge, Log, Mark done). If no action buttons are visible, check whether the coach/nudge endpoint returned HTTP 204 (no active nudges) — this is valid behaviour for a QA account with no active behaviour triggers.
steps.expected: EITHER: (a) nudge action buttons are present and clickable — click one and verify a state change occurs; OR (b) the panel shows an empty state (no active nudges, coach showing generic guidance, or 204 from the API) — this is PASSING, not a failure. Do not fail this step if no nudge buttons are present when the API returned 204.

steps.description: Verify nudge panel state persists across navigation (or empty state persists if no active nudges)
steps.action: Click the 'Dashboard' tab in the sidebar to navigate away from the helper/nudge surface. Wait for the dashboard to fully load. Then click back to the helper/nudge tab.
steps.expected: The panel loads without error after navigation. If nudges were actioned in step 6, they remain dismissed. If the panel was in empty/204 state, it remains in empty state. Either outcome is a PASS — the key invariant is that the panel renders without error.

steps.description: Verify nudge panel gracefully handles no active nudges (empty state)
steps.action: If all nudges have been dismissed in the previous step, observe the current state of the nudge panel.
steps.expected: An empty state is shown — either a friendly message (e.g. 'No nudges right now', 'All caught up'), a placeholder illustration, or a prompt to configure habits/goals. The panel does not show a blank white area or a raw error.

steps.description: Verify unauthenticated access to coach/nudge route is blocked
steps.action: Open a new browser tab (or use the Network tab to craft a direct fetch). Make a GET request to https://app.phronex.com/api/praxis/user/api/v1/coach (or the identified coach endpoint) without any Authorization header or session cookie.
steps.expected: The server returns HTTP 401 or 403. The response body contains an error message such as 'Not authenticated' or 'Unauthorized'. No nudge data is leaked to unauthenticated callers.

steps.description: Re-authenticate and confirm the helper surface is still fully functional after the unauthenticated probe
steps.action: Return to the authenticated session tab. Navigate to the helper/nudge surface again.
steps.expected: The helper/nudge surface loads correctly under the authenticated session. No stale error state from the unauthenticated probe is visible. The QA account's nudge state is intact as left after step 7.
